text:
maria.k: heads up — I found what looks like a prod webhook secret in a public gist linked from a repo forked yesterday. key starts with sk_wh_..., appears to be svc-webhooks-prod. filing here to coordinate.
security-oncall: thanks, can you paste the gist URL and sample line? we'll treat as compromise. I'll kick off rotation and containment now.
maria.k: https://gist.github.com/xxxx
maria.k: snippet: `Authorization: Bearer sk_wh_4Zj...` (redacted)
security-oncall: got it. steps: 1) revoke key 2) rotate new key 3) update secrets in k8s secret + vault/KMS 4) check logs for usage and customer impact 5) notify infra and CS if needed.
sam.j: running rotation script now: `./scripts/rotate_webhook_key.sh svc-webhooks-prod` — will report back.
sam.j: rotation done. new key pushed to Vault (transit via KMS).
devops-bot: [automated] secret-update: svc-webhooks-prod secret version 42 -> 43
devops-bot: [automated] key-revoke: sk_wh_4Zj... revoked
alex.g: looking at prod gateway logs — 32 requests from a single IP over last 6 hours, 12 of which triggered webhook deliveries. IP: 198.51.100.23, ASN: example-net. no obvious PII in delivered payloads.
security-oncall: good catch. can we replay payloads for those deliveries in staging to verify no customer data exfil?
sam.j: pulled payloads to staging S3 prefix `s3://sec-replay/1771234567/` — scrubbed, will replay with team.
nina.p: CS + legal should be prepped. recommend we notify customers whose webhooks fired with sensitive delivery. also update runbook with gist detection step.
security-oncall: agreed. @nina.p please draft a short customer-safe notice. @alex.g compile a list of affected customers (IDs) and timestamps.
alex.g: will do, exporting list now — sharing in #customer-impact when ready.
maria.k: how did gist get created? looks like forked from a personal account. I can reach out to the author to confirm.
security-oncall: low priority for author outreach until containment complete. after rotation, preserve gist URL and metadata for investigation.
security-oncall: postmortem actions: 1) ensure repo scanner flagged gist in future (add pattern for `sk_wh_`), 2) require bootstrap that prevents prod token checked into public gists (sso policy), 3) verify KMS auto-rotate for webhook keys quarterly.
sam.j: added a rule to secret-scanner: now matching `sk_wh_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}` — pushing to prod.
devops-bot: [automated] secret-scanner: rule added by sam.j — will run nightly.
security-oncall: final checklist before closing: revoked old token (done), rotated and updated secrets (done), audit log export (pending), customer notifications (pending), postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am. I'll create the incident channel.
maria.k: thanks all :thumbsup:
security-oncall: created channel #incident-webhook-gist-1771234567 and invited everyone.
